This document out 
 lines the major maintenance procedure P1, required for horizontal 
 volume displacement pump with rotating pistons with a supporting bearing, which performed 
 on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by 
eng. Hesham M. Hassan, reviewed by director eng. Saad Mostafa, and revised by 
quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gelil at EDEPCo., accepted by general director eng. Ali Al-Lithy
and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam: Head Sector of Talkha Steam 
 Power Station 2x210MW

Isolate the 
circuit breaker for the motor of this pump.

Isolate the 
electrical cable feeding of the motor of this pump.

The pump must 
be isolated mechanically by closing suction and delivery
valve.

items:

 permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable ID safety category,

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes .... etc

maintenance tool set,

Cleaning

sections.text:
Removal of the 
pump with 
gearbox

items:
Check the closing of the suction, delivery, heating steam and condensate
valve.

Prepare a tank for catching liquid from disconnected piping and from the
pump at which plug (28) is screwed off.
Disconnect suction and delivers piping from the pump.

Screw off the nuts of the coupling bolts. (Between input shaft of the
pumps gear box and the out put shaft of the separate gearbox).
Screw of the bolts (37) between the pump frame and foundation.
Lifting the pump with gearbox to the workshop.

Remove the coupling from the shaft of the pumps gearbox by using
suitable puller.

Screw off 
 nuts (1) to remove pump cover (15) from the pump body (26).

Screw off 
 bolts and nuts (36).

Remove the 
 pump body (26).

Screw of the 
 bolts of splice (35) and take them off.

Remove 
 rotating piston (14) by means of a puller. Which removed the bearing (34).

Remove the 
 gland body (16) even with the gland packing (18) even with the flanges (20).

Check the 
 bearing (34) and renewed if it need.

Check the 
 rotating pistons from mechanical wear and renewed if it need.

Check the 
 pump body from the mechanical wear and renewed if it need.

Check the 
 gasket between the pump cover (15) and pump body (26) and renewed if it need

Check the 
 gasket between the pump body (26) and gland body.

Check the 
 two shaft of the pump and renewed if need.

Check the 
 gland bush and renewed if need.

Chang the 
 gland packing with the suitable size.

Check the 
 sealing insert (13) and renewed if it needed.

Drain the 
 lubricating oil from the gearbox by screw of plug (23).

Dismantle 
 the cover (25) from the gear box body (10) by screw of bolts (38).

Screw off 
 the nuts (39) from the two shafts of the gearbox.

Remove the 
 bearing cover (4).

Hammering on 
 the input shaft (22) of gearbox but it must be put a wooden piece between the 
 hammer and the shaft.

Take out the 
 driver and driven shaft of the gearbox.

Pull out the 
 bearing from the two shafts (21, 22).

Pull out the 
 gear wheels (8) by using puller.

sections.text:
Inspections of the 
pumps 
gearbox parts

items: Check the spur gear wheel (8) and renewed if it needed.
Check the bearing and renewed if it needed.
Check the oil seal (11) and renewed if it needed.

Check the gasket between cover (25) and gearbox body (10) and changed it
if need.

sections.text:
Assembly of
the 
pumps
gearbox parts

items: Clean every part of the gearbox
Assembly every part in reverse sequence of disassembly.

After assembly the gearbox it must be rotated by put the coupling in the
driver shaft (22) and rotated it.
Clean well every part of the pump.

Assembly every part in reverse sequence of disassembly of the pump to the
gear box.

After finishing the assembly of the pump to the gearbox we must be
rotating the driver shaft (22) easy by using the coupling.

sections.text:
Installing 
the 
pump 
with the 
gearbox 
to the 
foundation

items:
Install the pump with the gearbox in reverse sequence of the removal
sequence .

sections.text:
Re-Alignment of the 
pump to the separate gearbox

items: According to the MPIS doc # cpl-001-r0

sections.text:
Change the 
packing of the stuffing box

items: Clean the surfaces of the stuffing box and shaft well.

Wire the suitable packing size on a part of shaft with the same diameter
of the pump shaft.

The number of turns is equal to the numbers of rings needed in the
stuffing box.
Cut all packing rings along the shaft by using a sharp knife.

Fit the rings in the stuffing box with the cut turned 180o 
 , starting at 9 clock.
The packing should never be knocked as they then may become damaged.

Remember that in a stuffing box there must always be as light leakage of
the fluid.

Do not tighten the gland hard to prevent the rise in temperature of the
stuffing box.

sections.text:
Refilling the
pump's
gearbox by
lubricating oil

items: Prepare the suitable lubricating oil in a clean bottle.
Open the plug (7).

Fill some lubricating oil and turn the gearbox by hand many times to
clean gear box.
Open the plug (23) and drain the oil, which used to clean.

Checked

Date :
